summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, reporting movements in authorized share capital and issued shares for July 2026. The filing shows a decrease of 31,089,752 ordinary shares, leaving total issued shares at 19,174,988,918. This is a routine regulatory disclosure with no special-situation event, no transaction terms, and no strategic action. It is not an acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other classified special situation. The filing simply confirms compliance with public float requirements and provides standard share capital information.
